name: assessing emsenn (YouTube) demand
from: Demand emsenn (YouTube) took up from the work board (a request it promised or a report it adopted), held unassessed in its own root.
to: The demand is either emsenn (YouTube)'s own work, admitted under the taken subject as items its own offices bear duties for, with any part it does not do posted back on the board; or it is given back (released or declined) with the reason it is not emsenn (YouTube)'s work.
cost: Bounded assessment attention of emsenn (YouTube)'s lead on the host's execution capacity; no financial, credential or external commitment.
otherwise: Demand about the emsenn YouTube channel's videos, schedule and curriculum stays open on the board, at home with the micro-enterprise seated over the enclosing section or, where none is, owed to the market; nobody else holds emsenn (YouTube)'s work.
receiver-condition: The thread's assayer, or an office of its opener, reads the assessment's evidence and accepts or declines it; the lead never receives its own assessment.
